## Displacements and Seismic Coefficients {#sec-newmark_results}

The displacement figures shade the damage thresholds of Chapter [-@sec-criteria] as bands of $D_n/H_s$ at `r paste(.fmt(DAMAGE.CUTS, 1), collapse = ", ")`% of the slope height, and the coefficient figures shade the same thresholds on the $D_a/H_s$ axis; each demand tab groups the material–geometry combinations for one return period or the MCE, with colors for materials and line patterns and widths for geometries.

### Newmark Displacement Curves {#sec-dn-curves}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/Dn.qmd",
    stem = "dn-curves",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(MODELS = c(rigid = "Rigid Models", flexible = "Flexible Models", ensemble = "Ensemble Models"), CAP = readCaption("fig.Dn"), CAP.MCE = readCaption("fig.Dn.MCE")),
    root = root,
    anchor = "sec-newmark-curves-site",
    context = "Newmark displacements"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
